messages:
Alex: Quick pulsecheck for the SEA region cutover tomorrow. Need final owners + any blockers for routing policy, KMS residency, egress paths, and proxy ACLs. @Priya @Leo can you confirm routing/KMS status?

Priya: Routing PR is merged (see PR #3421) but proxy iptables needs a small ACL change before traffic shift. Added runbook link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3421

Leo: KMS policies are ready on our side, but legal asked for one more residency confirmation for a few EU-origin customers routing through SEA. Filed policy PR #3429, waiting on a short review.

Jamal: Egress for embeddings -> customer S3 requires VPC peering + route table update. Opened INF-1982 for the peering work, assigned to me.

Sarah: Oncall confirmed for canary window 02:00-04:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll be primary, @ops-bot will page if latencies spike. :thumbsup:

Alex: Who's taking proxy owner for the iptables change? @ops-bot can we schedule the patch during the canary window?

Leo: I'll take proxy owner. Will push patch but need ACL order approval from @Priya first. Ping me at 11:00 PT if I don't self-assign.

Priya: reviewing now, left one nit about ACL ordering. Example snippet I want to keep stable:

```
- route:
    match: "region == 'sea'"
    dest: sgp-proxy-01
    priority: 100
```

infra-bot: Deploy plan created: canary 5% starting 2026-03-18T02:00Z, ramp to 25% after 30m if latency < 250ms, auto-fallback to hosted variants on error.

Jamal: INF-1982 assigned to me, ETA EOD today for peering and route table change. I'll post the peering CIDRs here when ready.

Alex: OK. Last call — any blockers that would stop cutover? If none, I'll mark ready and hand off to oncall + ops for the run.

Priya: No blockers on routing once the ACL nit is fixed and Leo's proxy patch is merged.

Leo: Patch submitted at 3955554380 and linked to PR #3450 (iptables diff included).

Alex: Thanks all. Final owners for cutover: routing = Priya, proxy + kms = Leo, egress = Jamal, oncall = Sarah. I'll mark this thread as the handoff doc and follow up post-canary.
